argv:
set -e
source /home/sicarii/opt/gnat/env.sh
export GPR_PROJECT_PATH="$PWD/scratch/phase1-direct/private-sparklib/lib/gnat:$GPR_PROJECT_PATH" WORLDLINE_PRIVATE_SPARKLIB_PREBUILT=True
export WORLDLINE_CORE_LIB="$PWD/lib/libworldline_core.so" PYTHONPATH=runtime:tests
gnatprove -P core/worldline_core_sources.gpr -u worldline-custody_v2_load_input.adb --no-inlining --mode=flow --report=all --checks-as-errors=on --proof-warnings=on --warnings=error -j2 --subdirs=direct-proof-custody-next-line -XWORLDLINE_BUILD=checks -XSPARKLIB_MODE=full -XSPARKLIB_BUILD=Production -XSPARKLIB_LIBRARY_TYPE=static -XSPARKLIB_INSTALLED=True
cp obj/core/direct-proof-custody-next-line/gnatprove/gnatprove.out records/phase1-direct/custody-load-runtime-v2/flow-report.txt
python refresh_contract_pins.py --check > records/phase1-direct/custody-load-runtime-v2/pins-check.json
for project in worldline.gpr tests/custody_load_contracts.gpr records/phase1-direct/custody-view-byte-repaired-v1/probe.gpr; do
 gprbuild -p -j2 -P "$project" -XWORLDLINE_BUILD=checks -XSPARKLIB_MODE=full -XSPARKLIB_BUILD=Production -XSPARKLIB_LIBRARY_TYPE=static -XSPARKLIB_INSTALLED=True -cargs:Ada -fPIC
done
./records/phase1-direct/custody-view-byte-repaired-v1/probe
python tests/generate_custody_load_fixtures.py
./bin/custody-load-contracts/custody_load_decode_tests tests/custody_load_empty.json 0 maximum
./bin/custody-load-contracts/custody_load_decode_tests tests/custody_load_empty.json 0
./bin/custody-load-contracts/custody_load_decode_tests tests/custody_load_populated.json 1 maximum
./bin/custody-load-contracts/custody_load_decode_tests tests/custody_load_populated.json 1
./bin/worldline_core_tests
./bin/worldline_core_fuzz
python -m unittest -v test_custody_native_guard test_custody_prepared_abi test_custody_v2_explicit_provision test_custody_provision_kernel test_custody_v2_sql_capture test_custody_foreign_key_capture test_root_worker_codec_lossless
